title: Host Terms, Section 11 — Snoozing, Unlisting, Relisting and Removing a Listing (Listings)
content:
# Section 11 — Snoozing, Unlisting, Relisting and Removing a Listing

*Roamhaven host terms for Roamhaven Listings.*

**11.1 Snooze.** The host may pause new bookings on a listed listing for a date range (the listing becomes snoozed). A snoozed listing returns to listed on its snooze end date or when the host ends the snooze.

**11.2 Unlist and relist.** The host may take a listed or snoozed listing out of search indefinitely (the listing becomes unlisted), and may relist an unlisted listing.

**11.3 Confirmed stays continue.** Snoozing and unlisting stop new bookings only. Confirmed stays go ahead, as the space type provides, and the host remains bound to them.

**11.4 Removal.** The host may permanently deactivate an unlisted listing. A listing can be removed only when none of its stays is requested, confirmed or checked in; the host must first resolve those stays, and a host cancellation of them is a host cancellation under the Host Accounts charter. Whether a stay is open is read from the listing's stays as Roamhaven's system records them.

**11.5 Removal is permanent.** Where the space type does not allow a removed listing to be relisted, a removed listing never returns, and the host creates a new listing instead.

## Stay statuses and removal

| Status of a stay on the listing | Prevents removal? |
|---|---|
| requested | yes |
| confirmed | yes |
| checked in | yes |
| completed | no |
| cancelled by the guest | no |
| cancelled by the host | no |
| declined | no |
| expired | no |

## Questions the section answers

**A host snoozes a listing for the holidays. What happens to a stay already confirmed for those dates?**
It goes ahead, and the host remains bound to it; only new bookings stop.

**A host wants to remove a listing that still has one stay checked in.**
The listing cannot be removed while that stay is checked in.

**A host removed a listing last year and now wants it back.**
A removed listing never returns; the host creates a new listing instead.
